correctness.rationale: Explicit finite model on 16 even-parity five-bit words and Hamming-distance-four edges. All 808 faces are reconstructed. Every one of 256 elementary free-face collapses is verified in the current face poset. Collapsed 2-complex has 16 vertices, 120 edges, 160 triangles; contracting its star spanning tree yields 105 generators and 160 attaching words. A verified sequence of 104 one-generator/one-2-cell CW cancellations leaves exactly one circle with 42 zero-degree and 14 degree-plus/minus-two 2-cells. One ±2 attaching cell yields RP2, every other ±2 cell attaches trivially after the first and contributes S2; total 55 S2. Independent F2/F3/F5 simplicial boundary ranks are 104/105/105. This proves the homotopy equivalence, not merely the homology or conjectural pattern.

value.rationale: Complete integral homotopy of the canonical (16,5,0,2) folded-five-cube closed-neighborhood complex: a genuine RP2 summand and precisely 55 2-spheres. Its nontrivial pi1 and H1 torsion are invisible to rational Betti numbers, and contrast sharply with the known open Clebsch complex wedge of 31 spheres. The exact finite classification is topologically motivated and useful for understanding when graph Čech complexes fail to be sphere wedges, not an arbitrary unmotivated numerical slice.
